intentional_modifications.category: LF15 Causal Source Fix: Anti-Spoofing Precedence in Domain Authorization
intentional_modifications.justification: Reordered cashier anti-spoofing evaluation before generic supervisor permission checks, preventing unreachable dead code and returning canonical 'authorization.spoofed_supervisor_rejected' whenever a cashier self-authorizes without supervisor role.

intentional_modifications.category: LF15 Causal Source Fix: Preflight Authorization Parity with Application Layer
intentional_modifications.justification: Aligned HTTP controller preflight validation error codes ('authorization.supervisor_id_required', 'authorization.invalid_supervisor_pin', 'authorization.reason_required', 'authorization.supervisor_permission_denied') and added caller anti-spoofing check via HttpContext.GetActorContext() returning 'authorization.spoofed_supervisor_rejected'.

intentional_modifications.category: LF15 Dedicated Named Behavioral Proof Tests (Application Service)
intentional_modifications.justification: Updated T11_SupervisorAuth_SpoofedActor_Rejected to assert canonical 'authorization.spoofed_supervisor_rejected', and added T11b_SupervisorAuth_UnprivilegedSupervisor_PermissionDenied asserting 'authorization.supervisor_permission_denied'.

intentional_modifications.category: LF15 Dedicated Named Behavioral Proof Tests (Server Controller)
intentional_modifications.justification: Enhanced FakeIdentityReadRepository with per-user permission overrides and added 5 dedicated named tests proving preflight parity: (1) input validation error codes, (2) lifecycle preflight parity with application authorization, (3) caller anti-spoofing rejection with 403, (4) unprivileged supervisor rejection with 403, and (5) authorized supervisor 200 OK with cryptographic SHA-256 token.
